title: Fire party communication
goal: Keep the BA board, read back names, times and pressure, and report that a fire is out.

l24-01.text: Fire! Fire in the galley! The pan is on fire!
l24-01.es: ¡Fuego! ¡Fuego en la cocina! ¡La sartén se prendió fuego!

l24-02.text: Fire, fire, fire. This is not a drill. Fire in the galley, main deck. Fire party to the scene. All other crew to the muster station.
l24-02.es: Fuego, fuego, fuego. Esto no es un zafarrancho. Fuego en la cocina, cubierta principal. Brigada de incendio a la escena. El resto de la tripulación al punto de reunión.

l24-03.text: Diego, you're with me. Take the BA board. Write every name and every time.
l24-03.es: Diego, venís conmigo. Agarrá el tablero de BA. Anotá cada nombre y cada hora.

l24-04.text: Yes, Second. I'll take the BA board.
l24-04.es: Sí, segundo. Me encargo del tablero de BA.

l24-05.text: Mario, did you use the fire blanket?

l24-06.text: Yes, but the fire broke out again, up in the extractor. Too much smoke.
l24-06.es: Sí, pero el fuego se volvió a desatar, arriba en el extractor. Demasiado humo.

l24-07.text: Team one, Rolando and Santos, ready to enter?
l24-07.es: Equipo uno, Rolando y Santos, ¿listos para entrar?

l24-08.text: Team one ready. Entry time eleven thirty-five. Pressure two hundred bar.
l24-08.es: Equipo uno listo. Hora de entrada once treinta y cinco. Presión doscientos bar.

l24-09.text: Team one: Rolando, Santos. Entry eleven thirty-five. Two hundred bar. Written.
l24-09.es: Equipo uno: Rolando, Santos. Entrada once treinta y cinco. Doscientos bar. Anotado.

l24-10.text: Team two, start boundary cooling on the galley bulkhead, and back up team one.
l24-10.es: Equipo dos, empiecen el enfriamiento de límites en el mamparo de la cocina, y apoyen al equipo uno.

l24-11.text: Team one at the extractor. Small fire. We're putting it out with CO2.
l24-11.es: Equipo uno en el extractor. Fuego chico. Lo estamos apagando con CO2.

l24-12.text: Second, team one has been inside for ten minutes.
l24-12.es: Segundo, el equipo uno ya lleva diez minutos adentro.

l24-13.text: Thanks, Diego. Team one, check your pressure. Over.
l24-13.es: Gracias, Diego. Equipo uno, controlen su presión. Cambio.

l24-14.text: Pressure one hundred and forty bar. The fire is out. Repeat, the fire is out.
l24-14.es: Presión ciento cuarenta bar. El fuego está apagado. Repito, el fuego está apagado.

l24-15.text: Bridge, fire party. The fire in the galley is out and contained. No injuries. Boundary cooling continues. Over.
l24-15.es: Puente, brigada de incendio. El fuego en la cocina está apagado y contenido. Sin heridos. El enfriamiento sigue. Cambio.

l24-16.text: Received. Well done, everybody. Keep a fire watch for one hour. Over.
l24-16.es: Recibido. Bien hecho, todos. Mantengan una guardia de incendio por una hora. Cambio.

l24-17.text: Good board, Diego. Every name, every time. That's how we bring everybody back.
l24-17.es: Buen tablero, Diego. Cada nombre, cada hora. Así es como traemos a todos de vuelta.

p-written.text: Entry eleven thirty-five. Two hundred bar. Written.
p-written.es: Entrada once treinta y cinco. Doscientos bar. Anotado.

p-backup.text: Team two, back up team one.
p-backup.es: Equipo dos, apoyen al equipo uno.

p-board.es: Me encargo del tablero de ERA.

m-board.es: Me encargo del tablero de ERA.

m-readback.text: Team two: Bautista, Lim. Entry eleven forty. Two hundred bar. Written.
m-readback.es: Equipo dos: Bautista, Lim. Entrada once cuarenta. Doscientos bar. Anotado.

m-time.text: Second, team one has been inside for fifteen minutes.
m-time.es: Segundo, el equipo uno lleva quince minutos adentro.

m-out.text: Bridge, the fire is out. No injuries.
m-out.es: Puente, el fuego está apagado. Sin heridos.

c-take.text: Diego, you're with me. Take the BA board.

c-team2.text: Diego, team two: Bautista and Lim. Entry time eleven forty. Pressure two hundred bar.

c-howlong.text: Diego, team one went in at eleven thirty-five. It's eleven fifty now. Tell me.

c-report.text: Fire party, bridge. What's the situation? Over.

c-time-other.text: Team one ready. Entry time eleven forty-two. Pressure two hundred bar.

c-out-other.text: Pressure one hundred and twenty bar. The fire is out.

screens.title: Three phrasal verbs for fire
steps: A fire broke out in the galley. (empezar de golpe)
We're putting it out with CO2. The fire is out. (apagar)
Team two, back up team one. (apoyar, respaldar)
paras: A phrasal verb is a verb + a small word, and the meaning changes: put is poner, but put out is apagar.
The fire is out is the sentence everybody wants to hear. Say it twice on the radio.
screens.avoid: The fire is off · We're putting off the fire

screens.q: The fire has stopped completely. You say…
A fire started suddenly in the engine room. A fire…
Team two, back up team one.

screens.title: Read back the numbers
paras: At the BA board you repeat what you hear and say Written at the end. Times in 24 hours (Lesson 8): eleven thirty-five. Pressure in bar, always the same word.
No Spanish words on the radio: not once y treinta y cinco, not bares.
screens.avoid: Eleven and thirty-five · two hundred bars

screens.q: What's the entry time? Write it with four numbers.

screens.title: bar, board, BA
paras: bar: one short syllable, no s in the plural: two hundred bar.
BA: letter by letter, bee-AY. board sounds like bord, long.
